title: Core: AS2 conditional compilation (#ifdef)
description: Test AS2 conditional compilation directives: #include 'file.as', #initclip / #endinitclip. Also test conditional attribute: [Inspectable], [Event], [Bindable], [RemoteClass]. Verify that unknown/unsupported directives either produce a meaningful parse error or compile successfully (not crash). Test that // comments inside conditional blocks don't break parsing.
